messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: `metering.token-count.delta > 5%` (critical) for customer-facing usage pipeline - pagerduty.inc/PD-98765 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Pager fired: PD-98765 -> escalation policy: metering-oncall. Initial alert: token_count_delta = 7.8% over 15m (threshold 5%).
Jia (oncall): acked. I'm on it — pulling logs and checkpoints now. @Sam FYI could be invoice risk.
Sam (Billing): on it — if token counts are low we might underbill; if high, customers could be overbilled. Need ETA for root cause.
Anya (SRE): quick note: saw a similar pattern last week when upstream kafka lagged and compacted messages were processed twice. Will check consumer offsets.
Mike (Eng-Platform): assigning me to investigate ingestion schema changes. Any deploys to metering in the last 2 hours?
Jia (oncall): nothing in deploy history for metering since 2:00Z. I see a spike in `metering.ingest-retries` around the same window.
Anya (SRE): running a diagnostic query against the ledger store:
```sql
SELECT hour_bucket, SUM(observed_tokens) as observed, SUM(reported_tokens) as reported, (observed - reported) as delta
FROM metering.usage_aggregates
WHERE hour_bucket >= '2026-03-14T08:00:00Z'::timestamptz
GROUP BY hour_bucket
ORDER BY hour_bucket DESC
LIMIT 24;
```
Anya (SRE): results show repeated deltas of +~6-10% for a subset of customers on the ingestion path id=ingest-12.
Mike (Eng-Platform): that ID corresponds to the new decompression worker we promoted yesterday. Rolling it back to confirm?
Jia (oncall): agree. We should rollback or route traffic away before backfill. Sam, can you flag invoices to hold if we can't get clean counts within 6 hours?
Sam (Billing): holding any auto-finalization for invoices generated in the last 24h. I'll create a manual list to review.
Mike (Eng-Platform): scheduling a rollback now. Command: `infra deploy rollback metering-ingest --to revision=2026-03-13-8472`
Ops Bot: Deploy rollback initiated by Mike (Eng-Platform). Job id: job-5532. Watch: https://ci.redwood/ops/job-5532
Jia (oncall): rolling window for monitoring muted (temporary) to avoid noise during mitigation: `/alerts mute metering.token-count.delta 30m`
Anya (SRE): also starting a targeted reprocess for impacted shards to correct already-ingested counts. Command to kick off backfill:
```
./tools/metering-backfill --shard ingest-12 --start 2026-03-14T00:00:00Z --end 2026-03-14T12:00:00Z --priority high
```
Anya (SRE): backfill queued; estimated run time 18-30 minutes for this window.
PagerDuty: Alert PD-98765 acknowledged by Jia (oncall). Escalation paused.
Ops Bot: rollback job-5532 completed: success. Deployed revision=2026-03-13-8472.
Mike (Eng-Platform): rollback completed, verifying consumer offsets and decompress worker dead-letter queue.
Anya (SRE): after rollback, delta dropped to 0.8% in the latest 5m window. Backfill job is running and has processed ~40% of shards.
Sam (Billing): thanks. I'll keep invoices on hold for affected customers; opening a ticket for finance ops to review adjustments once backfill completes.
Jia (oncall): starting cross-team postmortem stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MET-1234 - please add notes and timeline.
Mike (Eng-Platform): adding root cause hypothesis: decompression worker introduced duplicate token counts when a retry occurred while inflight. Patch to add idempotency is in review: PR #4592.
Anya (SRE): monitoring shows reprocess corrected counts for 92% of impacted accounts so far. Remaining accounts are in the slowest shard; leaving as high priority until 100%
Sam (Billing): estimated invoice impact if backfill completes: <$500 for this window; we'll prepare a customer comms draft in case.
Jia (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 25m. @Mike you'll take follow-up on the platform patch and @Anya keep an eye on the backfill until it's finished. I'll update rotations.
Mike (Eng-Platform): acked — will push idempotency patch if tests pass, will coordinate release with Anya.
Anya (SRE): putting final verification query in a minute and will paste result.
Anya (SRE): verification:
```sql
-- after backfill
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delta > 1) as accounts_above_1pct
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(observed_tokens) - SUM(reported_tokens) as delta
  FROM metering.usage_aggregates
  WHERE hour_bucket >= '2026-03-14T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t;
```
Anya (SRE): result: `accounts_above_1pct = 3` (down from ~120). Those three are in shard ingest-12 slow path. Backfill ETA ~12m.
PagerDuty: PD-98765 auto-resolved (no further alerts).
Jia (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. Will convert to full incident report later. If finance needs urgent numbers ping Sam. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Billing): thanks team — filing billing adj ticket and keeping customer comms on standby.
Mike (Eng-Platform): PR #4592 merged to main with idempotency guard, scheduling canary deploy to verify.
Anya (SRE): backfill completed and final verification shows `accounts_above_1pct = 0`. Closing mitigation thread.
Jia (oncall): closing. Good job everyone :tada:
